FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
Date : 17.10.2020
Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
For Regular Resumption of Advocate Chambers
Upon considering the representation received from the Gujarat
High Court Advocates’ Association (GHAA), the Hon’ble High Court
of Gujarat is pleased to issue the following Standard Operating
Procedures to be adopted for Regular Resumption of Advocate
Chambers in the campus of High Court of Gujarat:
1. The Advocates who have been allotted chambers will be
allowed entry in Court Premises only after thermal
screening and providing requisite details viz. name,
mobile number, chamber number to the staff of the
Registry. The Entry & Exit of Advocates also will be from
Gate No.5 only. As far as possible the members may
ensure entry and exit once in a day.
2. The Timing for functioning of Advocate chambers will be
from 10.30 am to 2.30 pm on Court working days
(except Saturday and Sunday) with the prescribed odd
even formula:
a. 1st Week
i. Odd Numbered Chambers (Monday-
Wednesday-Friday)
ii. Even Numbered Chambers (Tuesday-
Thursday)
b. 2nd Week
i. Even Numbered Chambers (Monday-
Wednesday-Friday)
ii. Odd Numbered Chambers (Tuesday-
Thursday)
3. The Advocates who have been allotted chambers will be
allowed access to both old and new Chambers. Only one
junior will be allowed access to the Chamber. However,
no client or litigant and clerk or any other staff shall be
allowed access to the Chambers and the Court campus.
4. As far as possible use of Elevators (lifts) be avoided for
going upto second floor. Lift operators have been
directed to permit entry of maximum 3 persons at a
time. It would be mandatory to use stairs while going
downstairs.
5. There will be a single-entry point to Old and New
Advocate Chamber Building fitted with hand-sanitizer
machine provided by the Registry, and manned by the
staff of GHAA and Registry.
6. Following mandatory norms need to be followed by all
Advocates who are permitted entry in Court campus:
a. Wearing of mask at all the times.
b. Sanitizing the hands before and at the
time of entry and exit.
c. Strict adherence to the norms of social
distancing in the Chamber as well as
within the Court campus.
d. No outside food including tea and/or
coffee shall be permitted.
e. Library, Bar Association hall, Advocates
tea room & common rooms shall remain
closed until further orders.
f. Adherence to all the directions,
guidelines, SOPs, advisories issued by
Government of India, Hon’ble High Court
of Gujarat and State of Gujarat in respect
of the Covid 19 pandemic.
g. The members of GHAA shall remain in
contact with Shri J.G. Vithlani, Deputy
Registrar and Covid-19 Coordinator of
the High Court in case of any emergency
medical requirement.
h. GHAA shall nominate any one office
bearer as Covid Co-ordinator.
7. Persons displaying symptoms of flue, fever, cough etc.
shall not be permitted entry inside the Court campus.
8. Housekeeping staff will ensure sanitation of Lobby areas
in the Chamber building of Advocates post 2.30 pm on
daily basis. The GHAA should ensure that chambers of
Advocates are sanitized on regular daily basis.
9. Gathering in lobbies and / or in one chamber be
avoided. GHAA shall inform all its members and shall
ensure its compliance.
10. In case if more than two positive Covid 19 cases are
detected the entry and access to the chamber shall be
suspended temporarily for deep cleansing and
sanitization as required.
11. Advocates should ensure that they restrict their
movements and not venture out towards Courts and
Administrative Buildings of the High Court.
12. Visit to Administrative branches for making enquiry
shall not be permitted.
Sd/-
Registrar General
High Court of Gujarat
